gaps.lead: The party was incredibly boring, so we left early.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ we left early.

gaps.lead: The match officials postponed the fixture because of the storm.
gaps.sentence: The fixture ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Postpone' = 'put off'; in the passive: the fixture was put off.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: My salary is half the size of my brother's.
gaps.explanation: 'Half the size of' reversed becomes 'twice as much as'.

gaps.lead: Jogging every morning was completely normal for him.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be accustomed to.

gaps.lead: Visitors may not feed the animals.
